summary: VERIFIED WITH NON-BLOCKING FINDINGS -- DURABLE-REGISTRY SIGNER REPAIR COMPLETE. BF-1 and BF-2 were independently reconfirmed unaffected, since 2F.4 touched only src/pcae/core/hatp_signing_ceremony.py and the HSCE-001 contract. The Fast Green exact node-ID diff found zero current-only new failures and zero error-set differences between the fixed and current trees. Five Non-Blocking findings were recorded and none are Blocking. No production source or contract was modified in this phase. No real provisioning, trust enrollment, HMIC action, certification, activation, Dell, runtime, PIV, or Stream-B action occurred.
